decisions.reason: The transactional email service is the flagship and builds directly on the firm's core messaging infrastructure and R&D, so the firm can read its results and keep improving it.
Document capture supports the firm's electronic document workflows, but recognition technology sits further from its messaging core, which leaves some risk of refocusing.
Email and fax conversion draws on long-held channel integration know-how and still serves regulated German customers who rely on fax.
The fax delivery feature is cheap to maintain close to the core fax service, though it may be folded quietly into the base offering.
Sandbox threat protection strengthens the growing email security portfolio, where the firm's existing security knowledge lets it absorb new threat information.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a natural part of the secure messaging service and is easy to operate and refine with the knowledge the firm already holds.
